title: Card on file created
description: Event generated after a card has been tokenized, becoming a *card on file*, and added to a customer's Pismo wallet. The Create card on file endpoint generates this event.

card_name.title: Card name
card_name.description: Cardholder name printed or embossed on card.

card_uuid.title: Card token
card_uuid.description: Card UUID token for use in transactions.

expiration_date.title: Card expiration date
expiration_date.description: Card expiration date in MMYY format

acquirer.title: Acquirer ID
acquirer.description: ID of acquirer that partners with Pismo.

card_profile.title: Card profile or color theme
card_profile.description: This field can be used to render the color or card image in payment app. This can be either a hex HTML color or the name of a profile that the issuer has registered with the network.

created_at.description: Date and time (RFC3339 format) when the card was added to the customer's wallet.

default_card.title: Cardholder's default card
default_card.description: Is this the cardholder's default card flag.

first_6_digits.title: First 6 card numbers
first_6_digits.description: First six PAN (primary account number) digits.

issuer_card.title: Issuer card flag
issuer_card.description: Is this card issued by the issuer flag.

last_4_digits.title: Last 4 card numbers
last_4_digits.description: Last four PAN (primary account number) digits.

metadata.description: Metadata added during card provisioning. Client created - no business rule validation is done.

skip_acquirer_validation.title: Skip acquirer validation flag.
skip_acquirer_validation.description: Should validation with acquirer be skipped flag.

verified.title: Issuer verified flag.
verified.description: Has the issuer already verified the card data flag.
